Amazing Mexican food but a strange atmosphere
Jul 2024 • Friends
The food was genuinely phenomenal. The burritos in particular were huge and tasted brilliant. The tortillas they came in were also fresh and some of the best I’ve ever had. The pricing was very fair and the staff were welcoming to us.

Towards the end of our meal we heard a lot of shouting out back which left a very tense and unsettling atmosphere and the owner was drinking with some friends of his which by the end they were very drunk which I find odd.

This did slightly dampen what was otherwise an amazing Mexican meal.

Nice Mexican spot for lunch

We also tried their chicken quesedia with jalapenos. All the items were pretty good. Can't compare to Mexican food I was used to while living in California but not bad to find it here. There only issue was there was only one person serving and preparing some of the dishes which took a lot of time.

Best mexican food in Vietnam
Jan 2024 • Friends
By far the best mexican food i have ever had, even though i didnt expect to find just that, in Vietnam.

Im travelling with my two friends, and we always love to try the mexican food across the world. Tippys food was the best we have tried so far.

Mold and Ants on the Nachos
Feb 2023 • Solo
The smell of this moldy food lingered in the apartment even after I took it outside and threw it in the trash. When I walked back in, I could still smell the rot of pork that had gone off. I called tippys to let them know that they had rotten food in their kitchen, and the person who answered, tried to correct the problem by sending me more food as an apology. So I will give credit there where credit is due. But there never should’ve been moldy food in the kitchen to begin with. That’s a revelation of an absence of good cleaning.
